changelog: **Klaviyo connector beyond profiles:** lists, segments and their members, metrics, allow-listed events (13-month retention, daily catch-up for late-delivered events), campaigns with their messages, campaign statistics (reporting API) and flows now sync alongside the profiles. Each resource has its own cursor, status and backoff in the new `ExternalSyncState` (a key missing one scope fails that resource alone); rows are upserted by provider id, a full pass prunes what the provider deleted. New tenant models `ExternalSyncState`, `ExternalAudience`, `ExternalAudienceMember`, `ExternalMetric`, `ExternalEvent`, `ExternalCampaign`, `ExternalCampaignMessage`, `ExternalCampaignStat`, `ExternalFlow` (all in `TENANT_MODELS`, cascading with the connection). The API revision moves from `2026-07-15` to `2026-10-15` and may be pinned with `KLAVIYO_REVISION` (GA only); the client retries up to 4 times (Retry-After, jittered exponential backoff), paces each endpoint family under its steady limit, and its only POST is the read-only `/api/campaign-values-reports` query. An erasure also removes the person's events and memberships. Optional server key `KLAVIYO_PRIVATE_API_KEY` + `KLAVIYO_ORG_ID` (fingerprint stored, never the key). Rules in `src/lib/klaviyoResourceRule.ts`, writer `src/lib/klaviyoResources.ts`; `docs/integrations/klaviyo.md` § Beyond profiles.

en: Klaviyo now brings in more than profiles: lists and segments with their members, e-mail engagement and order events, campaigns with their results, and flows — each with its own sync status on the integrations page.
tr: Klaviyo artık profillerden fazlasını getiriyor: üyeleriyle birlikte listeler ve segmentler, e-posta etkileşimi ve sipariş olayları, sonuçlarıyla kampanyalar ve akışlar — her biri entegrasyonlar sayfasında kendi eşitleme durumuyla.
de: Klaviyo bringt jetzt mehr als Profile: Listen und Segmente mit ihren Mitgliedern, E-Mail-Interaktionen und Bestell-Events, Kampagnen mit ihren Ergebnissen und Flows — jeweils mit eigenem Synchronisierungsstatus auf der Integrationsseite.
